fusions.name: Kick Clear
fusions.desc: A chop and a hind kick that deals 13 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Parting Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet over your shoulder that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Quick Feet, Quick Hands
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Running Start
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover raises your critical hit chance by 30% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
